svg.aria-label: ZAP-LABS, a web security cyber range. Break. Learn. Exploit. Defend. Break into 20 live targets across 10 vulnerability classes. Every target launches as your own ephemeral container with a fresh random flag, scored server-side. 4 security tiers per lab.
